sections.heading: What is trending: “opus 5.5”

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 22 Sep 2026 11:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-22T18:54:17+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-22T18:55:31+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Financial Times, Reuters, Yahoo Finance. The associated headlines are: “Anthropic unveils Claude Opus 5.5” (Reuters); “Anthropic releases cheaper AI model ahead of IPO” (Financial Times); “Anthropic launches Opus 5.5, its first model since CEO Amodei called for AI slowdown” (Yahoo Finance).
Google reports at least 1,000 searches in CA as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers CA. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
